Subject: PO 70021 — question on invoice timing & PO allocations

Hi Vivek,

Hope you’re well — we received PO 70021 and a couple procurement questions before we kick off invoicing. Two items to confirm so our AP team can accept the PO: 

1) Retroactive allocations: our billing cycles are month-based and we occasionally need to apply spend retroactively across the last two invoice periods when usage is re-allocated between cost centers. Can Redwood accept retroactive allocations that move part of November spend into December invoices (and vice versa), and if so what supporting fields do you need on the PO?

2) Invoice cutoff & Net terms: Clearline requires Net45 on vendor invoices but we also have monthly sweep run dates (cutoff is the last business day of the month). Will Redwood accept Net45 tied to the invoice run date, and are there any exceptions or processing fees to expect?

I attached the PO we plan to issue (Clearline_PO_70021.pdf). We can also provide an ERP export showing line-item allocations if that helps.

Thanks — want to get this sorted before our Q4 procurement freeze.

Best,
Samir Shah

Samir — thanks for the note and for attaching the PO. Quick answers up-front, and I’ll loop in Sales Ops (Ben) and Finance (Vanessa) for the details: 

- Retroactive allocations: generally yes, we can support limited retroactive allocation adjustments, but we need the PO to include the original invoice IDs or month flags so we can reconcile.
- Invoice cutoff: we bill per invoice run; Net45 would start from the invoice date. Our standard practice is to close the run on the last business day — adjustments after that may be included on the following invoice unless flagged as an approved retro allocation.
- Processing fees: there can be a small fee for post-cutover re-billing; we can waive it in cases where it’s a systems mapping issue that we introduce.

Ben/Vanessa: can you review the attached and confirm the maximum retroop window (how many invoices back we can apply) and whether we can formalize Net45 without fee if Clearline signs an amendment? I’m proposing we accept up to two invoice-period reallocations (same quarter) and offer Net45 with an amendment to the MSA plus a minimum monthly spend commitment — but want Ops and Finance to confirm.

Samir/Maya — attaching a quick multi-pay template to show the PO fields we need (redwood_multi-pay_template.xlsx). If you can populate PO line mapping and original invoice refs we’ll fast-track.

— Vivek

On Thu, Nov 19, 2026 at 5:03 PM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Ben/Vanessa: can you review the attached and confirm the maximum retroop window (how many invoices back we can apply) and whether we can formalize Net45 without fee if Clearline signs an amendment?

Team — operational notes below (summary + recommended options). Samir/Maya — copying so you have transparency into the constraints and the recommended path.

Summary of current policy and recommended exception for CL-70021:
- Standard policy: retroactive allocation requests are limited to within the same billing month or the immediately previous invoice when the request is filed within 30 days of the invoice date. This is to avoid significant ledger churn.
- Exception we can offer: for enterprise customers with an active PO and predictable monthly spend, we can extend an automated two-invoice retro allocation allowance (i.e., allow moving line items across the two most recent invoice runs) provided: (a) the PO includes original invoice refs or month codes, (b) Clearline agrees to a reconciliation window (30 days after the later invoice), and (c) we receive a single consolidated remittance per month (otherwise we lose the operational efficiency).

Net45 / Fees:
- Net45 start date: invoice date.
- If Clearline requires Net45 but also requests multiple split remittances or manual reconciliations, we typically assess a 1.5% manual processing fee per adjusted invoice.
- We can waive the processing fee conditionally if Clearline signs an amendment to the MSA that: (i) commits to a $250,000 minimum monthly billing volume OR (ii) agrees to consolidated monthly remittance and provides structured PO mapping via the template.

Required PO fields for us to process retro allocations cleanly:
- PO number, PO line ID, cost center code, original invoice run ID (YYYY-MM), quantity delta notes, and a short justification field.

Suggested next steps:
1) Clearline populates the redwood_multi-pay_template.xlsx with the mapping for PO 70021 and marks any lines they may want to retro-allocate.
2) If they need Net45 without fee, draft the simple amendment (I can have Legal prepare a short addendum; Vivek — please confirm commercial).
3) Once fields are validated we’ll process a one-time retro allocation across two invoice runs for November/December as a pilot.

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call to walk through the template tomorrow morning.

— Ben Carter
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

- For Net45: Clearline’s AP needs Net45 without recurring processing fees because our treasury forecast is locked; we can meet the $250k monthly threshold but need the amendment to be quick. What’s the earliest Legal can turn that around?
- If you want to test the pilot for November/December we can provide a clean mapping today. Is Redwood able to run the retro allocation as a single reissue to the December invoice so our payables team sees one consolidated invoice per month after adjustment?

If you’re ok, Samir and I can populate your template and upload it to the HubSpot attachment (HS-987654). Looking to close this before our procurement freeze next Wednesday.

I’ve asked Legal to prepare a 2-paragraph amendment and will route it for a 48-hour turnaround once you confirm. DocuSign link: https://redwood.app/docusign/CL-70021-AMEND
